findings.evidence: `rg -n "KernelBounds|isPositiveDefiniteKernel_eq_zero" KernelNullspace.lean` shows line 7 is a public import, while the only use of a KernelBounds declaration is `isPositiveDefiniteKernel_eq_zero_of_apply_self_eq_zero_left` in the proof at lines 121-122, not in any theorem statement.
findings.fix: Change line 7 to a non-public `import TauCeti.Analysis.PositiveDefinite.KernelBounds` and keep only `KernelFinsupp` public, since `KernelBounds` is used only in proof bodies such as line 121.
findings.issue: `KernelNullspace` publicly imports `TauCeti.Analysis.PositiveDefinite.KernelBounds` even though the exported signatures only mention the finsupp form/nullspace API; this makes all kernel-bound lemmas part of the downstream surface of importing nullspace.

summary: The nullspace declarations are usable without unfolding, but the module exports a proof-only dependency as part of its public import surface.
